setup.$comment: The "Your setup" forms (src/ui/learn/SetupForm.tsx): what each asks, and where the course says to look. `label` is the form's kicker and the Logbook's note; `**bold**` and `code` spans render as such; {issue}, {issueTitle}, {branch} (the practice branch: a session's base branch), {os} and {keys} are filled in. A form's `cites` names the course section each of its fields follows: `branch.hint` and `branch.example` cite the course's appendix (`appendix:git-worktrees`, Worktree, branch, and session: the app names a new session branch with your branch prefix and generated words), which the snapshot holds (`source.appendices`). `os.shortcut` is the shortcut shown with your computer's keys (src/learn/setup.ts formatKeys).

os.label: Your computer
os.title: Change your computer
os.intro: Shortcuts differ by computer. The course writes them for both: **Ctrl+R** (or **Cmd+R** on macOS). Pick the one you run the Copilot app on.
os.uses: The game will show the course’s shortcuts with your computer’s keys, in captions, Logbook pages, and quizzes.
os.note: Prompt history is **{keys}** on {os}. It stays on this device.

issue.label: Your practice issue
issue.title: Change your practice issue
issue.intro: The course’s **{issueTitle}** issue is #{issue}. If yours has a different number, type it here. In the app, type `#` in the prompt box and pick the issue by its title to see it.
issue.uses: Rook’s captions, your Logbook page, and the quiz will use your number.

branch.label: Your session’s branch
branch.title: Change your session’s branch
branch.intro: **Create from** started your session from `{branch}`, its **base branch**, in a new worktree with a working branch of its own. Select the session name at the top of the app’s window to see both, then type the working branch here.
branch.uses: The Practice Bough’s session terminal and your Logbook will show it.
branch.hint: The app names it with your branch prefix and a few words, like `octocat-bookish-invention`.
branch.base: That’s the **base branch**, where your session started. Your session works on a branch of its own: select the session name at the top of the window to see it.

model.label: Your model
model.title: Change your model
model.intro: For this exercise the course says: if **Copilot Fusion** is selected, keep **Standard**. Otherwise, select an available model. What does your model control show?
model.uses: Your Logbook will note it on the Try the controls page.
model.name: Its name, as the app shows it (optional)
